title: spike: Electron footprint baseline (S1)
body:
Measure what a bare Electron 45 window plus one blank `WebContentsView` costs on Linux: total RSS/PSS across processes, installed size, AppImage size, cold start. Try the planned optimisations (locale stripping, ASAR, no DevTools extensions, Ghostery blocker loaded from serialized lists).

**Time-box:** 2 days.

**Refs:** docs/requirements.md (NFR-01–05), ADR-0001

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Numbers for NFR-01 to NFR-05 committed under `spikes/s1-footprint/` with the script that produced them
- [ ] Recommendation: keep, or revise the budgets once (with an ADR)

title: spike: edge-reveal hot zones over WebContentsView (S2)
body:
Prototype a transparent UI overlay with 4 px hot zones above a page view; grow it to a panel on hover and shrink it back.

**Time-box:** 2 days.

**Refs:** ADR-0005

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Works on X11 and Wayland (GNOME, KDE), Windows 11, macOS
- [ ] Reveal latency and idle CPU measured
- [ ] Fallback (cursor polling) evaluated if a platform fails

title: spike: sign-in compatibility (S3)
body:
Check whether Google, Microsoft and one bank allow sign-in from an Electron browser with Crossbow's planned user agent and client hints.

**Time-box:** 1 day.

**Refs:** ADR-0001

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Result per service recorded
- [ ] Workarounds documented, or limitation added to privacy.md and README

title: spike: uniform fingerprint feasibility (S4)
body:
For every signal in docs/privacy.md's uniform table, find out whether Electron can set it natively, only through a main-world preload, or not at all. Test with CreepJS and Cover Your Tracks on two machines.

**Time-box:** 3 days.

**Refs:** FR-44, ADR-0004

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Table of signals × method × result committed under `spikes/s4-fingerprint/`
- [ ] privacy.md limits section updated
- [ ] Go / no-go for ADR-0004

title: chore: project scaffold (electron-vite, SolidJS, pnpm, lint, CI)
body:
Set up the repo layout from docs/architecture/overview.md, strict TypeScript, ESLint with the import-boundary rules, Vitest, Playwright in Electron mode, and a GitHub Actions workflow for Linux, Windows and macOS.

**Refs:** ADR-0001, ADR-0002, ADR-0006

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `pnpm dev` opens an empty Crossbow window
- [ ] Lint rule fails when `src/core` imports `electron` (NFR-21)
- [ ] Lint rule fails when a module imports another module or core internals (NFR-20)
- [ ] CI green on three platforms

title: feat: engine adapter (Electron)
body:
Define the `Engine` interface and its Electron implementation: sessions, views, request hooks, permissions, downloads.

**Refs:** NFR-21, architecture/overview.md#engine-adapter

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Core compiles without Electron types
- [ ] Unit tests against a fake engine

title: feat: module host, manifests and service registry
body:
Load manifests at start-up, lazy-`import()` enabled modules, resolve `requires`, track every registration through `ctx` and undo it on disable.

**Refs:** FR-01–03, ADR-0002

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] A disabled module's code is never loaded (test checks the module graph)
- [ ] Enable/disable live without restart for modules that allow it
- [ ] Settings → Modules lists modules with description, cost and breakage

title: feat: tabs in a single window
body:
Open, close, switch, reorder and pin tabs; vertical tab list model; page fills the window.

**Refs:** FR-10, FR-26

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Page fills the window with no permanent toolbar (FR-10)
- [ ] Keyboard shortcuts for new, close, next and previous tab

title: feat: edge-reveal panels (left, top, right, bottom)
body:
Implement the four panels as UI slots and the `edge-reveal` module from the S2 result. Classic fixed layout when the module is off.

**Refs:** FR-11, FR-12, ADR-0005

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Reveal delay and hide grace configurable
- [ ] Panels can be pinned
- [ ] Hot zones off in HTML full screen
- [ ] Every panel reachable from the keyboard (FR-12)

title: feat: command palette (Ctrl+K)
body:
Fuzzy search across tabs, commands and module toggles; later sources (history, bookmarks, workspaces) plug in through the service registry.

**Refs:** FR-13

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Opens in under one frame after the key press
- [ ] Modules can register commands

title: chore: performance benchmark in CI
body:
Automate the S1 measurements and run them on every PR; fail when a budget is broken. Also measure each module's cost for its manifest.

**Refs:** NFR-01–06

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Report comment on PRs
- [ ] Budgets from docs/requirements.md enforced

title: chore: Linux AppImage build
body:
Package with only needed locales, ASAR, compression.

**Refs:** NFR-03, NFR-04

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] AppImage ≤ 110 MB (NFR-03)
- [ ] Runs on Ubuntu 24.04 and Fedora

title: feat: sealed workspaces
milestone: M2 — Workspaces, tab groups and sharing
body:
One session per workspace with `session.fromPath`, per-workspace SQLite, lazy session creation, create/rename/recolour/icon/reorder/delete, switch with Ctrl+1…9.

**Refs:** FR-20, FR-21, ADR-0003

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] E2E test: same site in two workspaces shares no cookies, storage, cache or service workers
- [ ] Deleting a workspace removes its folder

title: feat: disposable workspaces
milestone: M2 — Workspaces, tab groups and sharing
body:
In-memory session and in-memory database; erased on close; never restored.

**Refs:** FR-22

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Test: nothing written under the profile folder while browsing in a disposable workspace

title: feat: tab groups
milestone: M2 — Workspaces, tab groups and sharing
body:
Named, coloured, collapsible groups within a workspace; drag tabs between groups; close a group; save and reopen a group.

**Refs:** FR-27, FR-28

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Group state survives restart
- [ ] Saved group frees its tabs' memory

title: feat: send tab or link to another workspace
milestone: M2 — Workspaces, tab groups and sharing
body:
Context menu, drag onto a workspace, and palette command; move or copy; URL cleaning and token warning before crossing.

**Refs:** FR-30, FR-31, ADR-0008

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] E2E test: no cookie, referrer or opener crosses
- [ ] Token warning offers send / strip / cancel

title: feat: Shelf module
milestone: M2 — Workspaces, tab groups and sharing
body:
Global list of links shown in every workspace, stored in profile.sqlite, expiring after 7 days; copy-to-workspace for selected text and links.

**Refs:** FR-32, FR-33, ADR-0008

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Works with the system clipboard untouched
- [ ] Expiry configurable

title: feat: per-workspace network routes (direct, proxy, Tor)
milestone: M2 — Workspaces, tab groups and sharing
body:
`network-routes` module using `session.setProxy`; detect a local Tor service; WebRTC off on proxy and Tor routes.

**Refs:** FR-23, FR-48

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Two workspaces on different routes show different IPs
- [ ] No WebRTC IP leak on proxy/Tor routes

title: feat: session restore
milestone: M2 — Workspaces, tab groups and sharing
body:
Restore workspaces, tabs, groups and scroll positions after restart or crash; tabs restored asleep.

**Refs:** FR-52

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Crash test restores the previous state
- [ ] Disposable workspaces never restored

title: feat: workspace indicator line
milestone: M2 — Workspaces, tab groups and sharing
body:
Thin coloured line along a chosen edge showing the current workspace colour.

**Refs:** FR-14

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Can be switched off and its edge chosen

title: feat: per-workspace module settings
milestone: M2 — Workspaces, tab groups and sharing
body:
Modules with `scope: workspace` can be enabled per workspace; default search engine per workspace.

**Refs:** FR-04, FR-24

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Content blocker off in one workspace only works

title: feat: content blocker module
body:
`@ghostery/adblocker-electron` per session; EasyList + EasyPrivacy; serialized lists loaded at start-up; updates from Crossbow release assets built by a scheduled workflow.

**Refs:** FR-40, ADR-0007

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Fits NFR-01 and NFR-05 in the benchmark
- [ ] No request to any host but the documented one

title: feat: URL cleaner and HTTPS-only modules
body:
Strip known tracking parameters on navigation; HTTPS-only interstitial for plain HTTP.

**Refs:** FR-41, FR-42

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Rule list unit-tested
- [ ] Interstitial allows a per-site exception

title: feat: secure DNS
body:
DNS over HTTPS with selectable provider, chosen at first run; system resolver option.

**Refs:** FR-43

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Provider switch takes effect without restart

title: feat: uniform fingerprint module
body:
Implement profile `uniform-v1.json` from the S4 results: native settings first, main-world preload second, letterboxing; per-site and per-workspace relaxation.

**Refs:** FR-44, ADR-0004

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Two clean installs on the same platform produce the same CreepJS and Cover Your Tracks fingerprint (CI)
- [ ] privacy.md table matches the implementation

title: feat: strict permissions, third-party cookies and WebRTC protection
body:
Deny-by-default permission handlers per workspace with a site permissions UI; block third-party cookies; WebRTC IP policy.

**Refs:** FR-45, FR-47, FR-48

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Permission prompts show the workspace name
- [ ] No local IP visible on WebRTC leak tests

title: feat: privacy panel and forget-this-site
body:
Right-edge panel listing blocked requests, third parties, permissions, fingerprinting attempts and route; erase one site's data in the current workspace.

**Refs:** FR-46, FR-49

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Costs nothing while closed (listens to bus events only)

title: chore: no-unexpected-requests check in CI
body:
Run Crossbow at start-up and idle behind a recording proxy; fail on any request not in privacy.md's list.

**Refs:** NFR-10, NFR-11

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Runs on every PR

title: feat: history and bookmarks per workspace
body:
Stored in each workspace's database, searchable from the palette.

**Refs:** FR-50

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Never visible from another workspace

title: feat: downloads panel
body:
Bottom-edge downloads panel, per workspace, with ask-where-to-save option.

**Refs:** FR-51

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Downloads in disposable workspaces cleaned from the list on close

title: feat: tab sleep and tab archive modules
body:
Sleep idle tabs after 30 min and under memory pressure by destroying their view; archive tabs unvisited for 12 h.

**Refs:** NFR-02, NFR-08, FR-29

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Sleeping tab ≤ 1 MB (NFR-02)
- [ ] Archived tabs searchable and restorable

title: feat: PDF, find in page, zoom, print, full screen
body:
Built-in browser essentials.

**Refs:** FR-54, FR-55

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Zoom remembered per site per workspace

title: feat: bookmark importer
body:
Import from Firefox, Chrome and HTML bookmark files into a chosen workspace.

**Refs:** FR-53

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Imports into the chosen workspace only

title: feat: opt-in signed updates
body:
Updater asked at first run; signed packages; CI builds a release automatically on each Electron security release.

**Refs:** FR-56, NFR-12

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Security release shipped within 7 days (NFR-12) — dry-run documented

title: chore: packages for Linux, Windows and macOS
body:
AppImage, deb, rpm, Windows installer, macOS dmg; reproducible build notes.

**Refs:** NFR-03, NFR-04, NFR-22

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Installed size ≤ 260 MB (NFR-04)

title: chore: accessibility pass
body:
Keyboard access to every feature and screen-reader labels on every control.

**Refs:** NFR-23

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Checked with Orca on Linux
